name: Soft 3D / candy C4D render
look: glossy soft-clay or glass objects, cloner arrays rippling, held hero compositions.

fits.notes: consumer apps, hardware, "delightful" brands. Overused in 2020-22

products: default pastel blobs with no concept

when_not: Overused in 2020-22; avoid default pastel blobs without a concept.

type.rule: Style type is for the world's chrome and display; the brand face always sets the real claim line and any product UI text.

colour.guidance: rounded sans (Circular, Recoleta, Gilroy); pastel gradients, 3 colours.
colour.rule: Style palette fills the world; the brand colour takes the role named in brand_lock.colour_role and never drops below the contrast of the brand's own palette.

keeps: real product UI capture (composited as a screen plate, never redrawn)
brand_lock.colour_role: brand colour on the hero object and light; pastel gradient from the brand tints
brand_lock.type_role: rounded sans for display; brand face for the claim
brand_lock.world_changes: glossy objects, cloner ripples, orbit with DOF breathing
brand_lock.rule: Under a brand lock the brand colour, type and logo stay; the style world (material, picture language, motion grammar, finish, sound) is what varies between looks. A branded launch shows 3 different style worlds.

motion_grammar.note: grammars lists existing library/grammars ids; grammars_planned lists world grammars the engine plan adds (game-world, tabletop, os-desktop, type-only, editorial, collage, cinematic-world).

effects_note: rasan-fx passes (runtime/rasan-fx.js); order is the pass order. {brand_colour} / {second_ink} are filled from the brand or look palette.

codex_assets.prompt_template: soft studio environment plate and hero object reference render of {subject}, glossy soft-clay or glass, pastel gradient background

animate_with.what: displacement / warp (shader fed by noise or depth)

codex_assets.r1_note: HDRI-like environment plates, hero object reference renders; or full-frame stills used as plates with A1/A3.
codex_assets.rules: Flat, evenly lit plain background (chroma green or pure white) for clean cut-outs; one prompt family with the same seed words; generate at 2x and downscale; never ask Codex for readable UI text or logos (typeset them in HTML).

build.engine_meaning: reference only (builder hand-codes it) / buildable today
build.recipe: `styles/3d-render.md`, `motion/3d-cgi/*`, `stage3d/recipes/hero-turntable.js`, `product-slab-evidence.js`. Three.js MeshPhysicalMaterial (transmission), RectAreaLight, bloom pass; `gsap` springs seeded by `t`.

examples.title: Nothing Phone launch films by FutureDeluxe

product_ui_rule: If the film shows RasanAI Studio, use the current dark sidebar UI with the Describe...Final dot stepper (docs/brand/studio-ui/), as a real capture composited INTO this style; never the retired light UI.

palettes.name: Pastel studio
palettes.words: pink studio backdrop, plum ink, bubblegum pink, periwinkle

palettes.name: Butter and sky
palettes.words: butter yellow, navy ink, tangerine, sky blue

palettes.name: Mint pop
palettes.words: mint backdrop, deep green ink, coral, sun yellow

brand_lock.rule: Brand colour is the hero object's material; the seamless backdrop and secondary shapes stay style-fixed pastels from the same family. Slots marked brand take the brand colour (exact hex); slots marked style keep the palette value; brand-or-style takes the brand colour only when its contrast against the other slot is at least 4.5:1, else the palette value.

scale.note: cqw = 1% of the frame width (1080p: 1cqw = 19.2 px)

pairings.note: Round humanist sans (a Circular/Gilroy stand-in); big and friendly.

scale.note: cqw = 1% of the frame width (1080p: 1cqw = 19.2 px)

type.load: In a HyperFrames composition add the two <link> tags from `google` to <head> (plus rel=preconnect to fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com), set font-family from `css`, and wait for document.fonts.ready before the first screenshot / timeline build. Offline renders: download the families once (they are OFL) into the project's fonts/ folder and use @font-face. The brand face always sets the real claim line and the product UI text; the style pairing is for the world's chrome and display.
type.rule: Style type is for the world's chrome and display; the brand face always sets the real claim line and any product UI text. Under a brand lock keep the brand face for the claim and use the pairing's display for labels only.

passes.role: tiny edge fringe for lens realism

finish.how: Runtime: RasanFX.create({ source, passes: [...] }) from runtime/rasan-fx.js, applied in the listed order, on the whole composition canvas or on the Codex plate only (plate-only when the type must stay crisp). `css` lists the cheap approximation kinds story boards and style frames draw with plain CSS (grain:<opacity>, scan:<opacity>, halftone, pixel, led-dots ...).

composition.grid: seamless cyc backdrop with a floor; one hero object centred or on a third; 2-3 satellite shapes
composition.product_ui: UI shown on a rounded glossy-matte device mockup or on a floating soft-edged card

codex.template: {subject} {action}, {setting}. Camera and lens: 85 mm studio product lens, f/4, slightly high angle, shallow depth of field. Lighting: large softbox key upper left, rim light from behind right, soft occlusion, subsurface feel. Material: soft rubbery matte plastic and satin, inflated shapes, rounded bevels, one glossy accent. Colour, locked to the palette {palette_words}, and nothing outside it. Texture and finish: none visible; very light film grain. Avoid: no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no sharp edges, no harsh shadows, no noisy textures, no metal chrome, no realistic skin, no text on objects.
codex.camera: 85 mm studio product lens, f/4, slightly high angle, shallow depth of field
codex.lighting: large softbox key upper left, rim light from behind right, soft occlusion, subsurface feel
codex.material: soft rubbery matte plastic and satin, inflated shapes, rounded bevels, one glossy accent
codex.colour_rule: Name the palette's colours in words (the palette's `words`), never hex codes; add 'and nothing outside this palette'. Pick one palette per film and keep it.
codex.texture: none visible; very light film grain

aspect.note: Plates: ask for about 12% bleed around the frame so the camera can travel; keep the calm side empty for type. Generate 16:9 for the frame, 1:1 for sprite sheets and objects.

consistency.anchor: Make the anchor plate first, approve it by eye, then pass it as --ref to every other image (imagegen batch does this with --world).
consistency.style_line: Append the world bible's style line (30-45 words, no hex) to every prompt.
consistency.seed_words: Keep these words verbatim in every prompt of the film: soft rubbery matte plastic and satin; 85 mm studio product lens; pink studio backdrop, plum ink, bubblegum pink, periwinkle.

sprite_sheet.rules: Not a sprite style. For a cut-out object or character use --transparent (flat #00FF00 key, then despill); one subject, no shadow plane.

do: Inflate shapes: large radius, no hard corners
One glossy highlight per object, the rest satin
Stay in one pastel family plus a single saturated hero

Heavy bloom that washes the form
